entrypoints.offline_contextual: python -m scripts.first_run plan --mode new --goal creative --preferred-skill painting --income-pressure

invariants.prerequisites: Python >=3.11 and Git; no unattended system installation
invariants.sims_executable: Game/Bin/TS4_x64.exe or TS4.exe in known locations or explicitly selected path
invariants.game_launch: deliberate double-click/explicit CLI auto invocation or manual chooser click; no background auto launch; subprocess without shell
invariants.save_selection: player-only until separately verified authorized save identity + calibrated local scene/action gating; never blind Resume or auto-select unknown saves
invariants.cas: Player creates the Sim; aspiration/traits are suggestions; base-game skill priorities are ranked advisory gameplay steps, never CAS-granted levels, automatic menu actions, or identity edits
invariants.protected_data: never read/write user saves or edit Sims game files
invariants.host_proof: process dispatch is not game load or Live Mode evidence
invariants.active_process: read-only bounded tasklist PID observation; if Sims already running, never launch a second copy; dispatch PID is not necessarily the actual game PID
invariants.menu_learning: NOT_OBSERVED unless future host captures independently certify scene/menu cues; no speculative detection or automatic menu clicks
invariants.single_install_detection: Two recognized executables (TS4_x64.exe and TS4.exe) sharing one validated Game/Bin path are a single installation; prefer x64. Separate validated Game/Bin roots stay ambiguous.
invariants.process_inventory_validity: Every Windows tasklist /FO CSV /NH row must have five columns and numeric PID; malformed/truncated inventories deny launch; independent pre-dispatch snapshots require validated identities, and untrusted post-dispatch data withholds game PID proof.
invariants.first_session: Goal/context/planned skill focus is player-supplied; six observed needs outrank optional practice, income/funds constrain paid equipment, player preferences outrank goal defaults; no claim to have observed outcomes

limitations: Read-only bounded default install discovery may require manual path selection
Existing game-host image-template navigator is independent and requires separately observed calibrated screenshots and strict screen lease
Gameplay and saved-session observations require an authorized Windows P08 run
Unique-install Windows auto-launch is not automatic loading of the latest protected user save; save identity and scene-safe navigation require dedicated local proof
Read-only Windows tasklist basenames do not independently attest the full executable path; same-time competing double-click windows still require local concurrency certification.

First-session skill priorities are unmeasured relative heuristics (base-game, adult-oriented examples), not a certified optimal build or a machine-learning model; re-evaluate against player age, packs, actual needs and preferences
No autonomous CAS, skill-level granting, job enrollment or first-day queue manipulation is released without exact game-build local proof and player-first admission
